comment: the served head, signed by the first log key this log's roots published (SPEC 9.4). Serve it in place of served/checkpoint over the same tiles. A reader holding only trust.cbor (`fresh`) MUST refuse it as log-signature: it has never seen the rotation. A reader that has replayed this log (`informed`) MUST accept it -- and MUST still accept served/checkpoint itself (`informed_reads_served`), because the anchor key is kept alongside the learned one, never replaced. The answers are all correct, and which applies depends on what the reader has done rather than on anything in the file
